response.sql: WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5 GROUP BY rating), overall_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS benchmark FROM rating_stats) SELECT rs.rating, rs.avg_rate_per_day, rs.film_count, rs.avg_rate_per_day / ob.benchmark AS avg_to_benchmark FROM rating_stats rs CROSS JOIN overall_benchmark ob WHERE ob.benchmark IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: Ratings with no films having rental_duration > 5 are excluded from both the result set and the benchmark calculation; the benchmark is the unweighted mean of only the per-rating averages that appear in the results
